description: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers, with a threshold of 1e-3, comparing three different conditions. The x-axis, labeled "Layer", has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 20, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio", also has a linear scale, spanning from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The blue dash-dotted line represents the sparsity ratio before gate, starting at approximately 0.03 at layer 0 and remaining relatively steady around 0.01 across the layers. The orange dotted line shows the sparsity ratio after gate, beginning at around 0.9 at layer 0, decreasing to approximately 0.05 at layer 10, and then fluctuating between 0.02 and 0.07 from layer 15 to 20. The green dashed line indicates the sparsity ratio after average gate, starting at about 0.7 at layer 0, dropping to around 0.05 at layer 7, and then stabilizing near 0.01 from layer 10 onwards.
